name: subagent-routing-kit
description: Hard-rule guard and delegation policy for Agent/Task subagent calls, ported from the agent-neutral subagent-routing-kit core. Blocks calls whose declared model has no capability-snapshot entry or fails a hard rule. The reasoning-effort axis is not enforced: Claude Code's native agent format has no field for it. See the bundled README for the full list of what this does and does not check.
